request: Exact native request bytes; matched question/source/assessment bindings; no policy prose added to provider request

counts.cli_launch_attempts: Wrapper requests to start an executable
counts.cli_invocations: Processes actually started; preparation/evaluation/replay are distinct
counts.transport_attempts: HTTP client invocations from a verified receipt; unknown if evaluation started and evidence is incomplete
counts.live_calls: Local fully written requests, not provider execution or billing attestation

integrity: Pinned executable and exact policy-file closure
Independent retained CLI checksum line and checksum file
Response file equals receipt raw response and its hash
Live partial-call record equals all required receipt call fields
Deterministic policy replay under retained receipt anchor
Canonical receipt field presence and TLS/body metadata consistency
capture: Intent precedes execution; failures and incomplete attempts remain reserved
Safe original process streams and preparation/failure/response artifacts retained before cleanup
Known credential echoes withheld rather than relabelled as original raw bytes
Cleanup errors remain explicit and do not erase captured evidence
Available validated usage extracted from verified raw response; absent usage stays null

authority.provider_evidence: Untrusted model judgements and reported identity
authority.policy: Distinct deterministic arbitration under frozen cARL packs and role
authority.receipt: Local integrity evidence, not a signed provider receipt

path_a: Existing Git-evidence interface, source, policy defaults and installed binary preserved
